column1: # tools/mutation/survivors.tsv: the reviewed baseline of mutation survivors.
# The nightly `linux / mutation` job (tools/mutation/run_mutants.py --baseline) fails on any survivor
# not listed here, on an `equivalent` entry whose mutant no longer survives, on a `gap` entry whose
# mutant no longer survives (remove it and lower the gap-ratchet), on an entry the generator no longer
# emits, and when the number of `gap` entries is not the gap-ratchet below. The per-commit lint runs
#   label   `equivalent` (no test can tell the mutant from the library: the reason says why) or
#           `gap` (a test is owed: the reason names it and where it would run)
#   n       the occurrence of the line's text among the file's lines with that same text (1 if unique)
#   mutated the mutated line's text, stripped
# Seeded 2026-11-12 from nightly run 43219892575 (head 76edea48e, slice 69/90): 168 survivors, each
# applied and judged (final-fable/FIX-VERIFY-D.md); 19 closed by tests on that day, the rest listed.
# The gap count only goes down: a new gap is added only with the gap-ratchet raised in the same change.
